title: Having Beer after Prayer? Measuring Cultural Bias in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the likelihood preference of large language models for Western entities over Arab entities (Cultural Bias Score) in masked text-infilling tasks, and evaluating performance disparities (such as F1 scores, false positives, and false negatives) in downstream tasks like Named Entity Recognition (NER) and sentiment analysis when prompts contain Arab versus Western entities.

Prompting language models to generate stories about characters with Arab versus Western names, and computing the Odds Ratio of specific extracted adjectives to identify biased associations (e.g., associating Arab names with poverty and traditionalism, and Western names with wealth and high status).
